name: Shedeur
overview: Shedeur is identified in Scripture as the father of Elizur, a prominent leader of the tribe of Reuben. The passages in Numbers highlight Elizur’s role as captain and prince over the Reubenites, consistently referred to as 'the son of Shedeur.' His leadership is emphasized through his responsibilities in organizing the camp, leading the army, and presenting peace offerings, underscoring Shedeur’s significance as the patriarch of a key tribal leader during Israel’s wilderness journey.
